summary: Implementation blueprint for Bhagyajyoti Saikia | Creative Designer portfolio website. Covers dark premium 3D-inspired brand styling (#0D0B12 / #8B5CF6), sticky top-bar navigation, hero section, 8 concept portfolio ads with non-cropping modal lightbox, 4 service offerings, transparent ₹99/ad pricing, about section, split contact options, detailed 11-field order form with photo uploads and WhatsApp handoff, private admin dashboard with Preview-Confirm-Publish workflow, SEO metadata, and data retention policies.
